name: Theory tabs show each assessment's central question
description: On the Theory page, clicking each of the four tabs (Solstice, Turing, Pride, Passage) reveals that assessment's central question in the panel, verifying both the tab interaction and the per-tab content.

planSteps.description: Verify the 'Inside each assessment' section shows a row of four tabs and the Solstice panel is shown by default with the question 'How do you burn, and which direction is your energy turning?'.
Verify the panel shows the question 'Does what you say about your mind match what your choices show?'.
Verify the panel shows the question 'How well do you know yourself, and how honestly do you show it?'.
Verify the panel shows the question 'Where does your attention sit, and how do you feel about time passing?'.
